source_documents.title: Understanding aggregation induced emission in a propeller-shaped blue emitter

reference_evidence_units.quote: The radiative rates obtained for both phases are very similar, the value for solution is slightly larger than the solid state rate.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Calculated spontaneous-emission rates in solution and crystal.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Radiative-rate enhancement does not explain the brighter crystal in this model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The result concerns this computational comparison, not every possible sample condition.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the out-of-plane rotation of the phenyl rings with respect to cyclopentadienyl ring are hampered because of geometrical restrictions imposed by the packing
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Normal-mode and reorganization-energy analysis in solution and solid.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model-based motion restriction should not be represented as a measured molecular trajectory.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The modes associated with the out-of-plane bending of the cyclopentadiene ring leading to the corresponding conical intersection are not significantly activated during the first 500 fs of dynamics.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Initial 500 fs of simulated excited-state dynamics.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The simulated early dynamics do not directly exhibit the CI-driving puckering motion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a limit of the trajectory window, not proof that CI decay is absent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: In the molecular crystal, because the S1–S0 MECI is classically inaccessible, the relaxation through this mechanism is disfavoured.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of optimized CI energies in vacuum and crystal.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The calculated crystal energy landscape suppresses access to a puckered CI.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: CI geometries and correlation-corrected energies use different methods; the claim is qualitative.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the enhancement of emission in the solid state is associated with the minimisation of decay through nonradiative mechanisms.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source conclusion from vibrational and excited-state calculations.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source attributes solid-state enhancement to suppressing nonradiative decay.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is an interpretation supported by calculations, not a new experimental result.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the complementary descriptions provided the RIR and RACI models.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper explicitly treats RIR and RACI as complementary accounts.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The two labels are not assumed to represent independent experimentally separated causes.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The crystal structure shows minimal π −π interactions and electronic ex- citations are not significantly perturbed by the crystal environment.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPC
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Source summary of the modeled crystal compared with isolated/solution descriptions.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source distinguishes crystal-induced motion restriction from a major change in electronic excitation caused by intermolecular interaction.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal packing alone must not be converted into an aggregate-exciton label; this statement does not exclude all weak intermolecular coupling.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The paper also explicitly relies on restricting modes that enable nonradiative relaxation.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal packing supplies the external constraint for the two central descriptions.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The modeled restriction of puckering-CI access is a central explanation.
